Research and Opportunities

Research
and
Opportunities

Find
Your
True
North

Colby offers students access to unique global experiences, hands-on research and internship opportunities, and the chance to try or create something new. Colby has funded more than 2,000 universal experiences and assembled a network of nearly 1,000 preferred recruiting partners, spanning all industries.

Institutes, Centers, and Labs

The
Island
Campus

As the steward of Allen and Benner Islands, Colby has a significant presence on the coast of Maine for a wide range of academic programs and activities. These islands offer undisturbed environments ideal for conducting interdisciplinary experiences—from sculpture and cinema to bird research and long-term climate monitoring.

NOTICE OF NONDISCRIMINATORY POLICY AS TO STUDENTS
Colby College admits students of any race, color, national and ethnic origin to all the rights, privileges, programs, and activities generally accorded or made available to students at the school. It does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, national and ethnic origin in administration of its educational policies, admissions policies, scholarship and loan programs, and athletic and other school-administered programs. See Colby's Nondiscrimination Policy and Compliance Information.
